sectors.trend: Iron ore in active 'bloodletting' phase; gold underperforming ('schmould'); small-cap miners raising capital aggressively via Canaccord-led deals
sectors.implications: BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX face margin compression; NNOX.AX slashing costs as cash burns; Sunstone Metals, Manuka Resources, PolarX volatile. Cap raises dilute equity holders.

sectors.trend: ANZ.AX cutting 3,500 jobs in structural cost programme; RBA rental inflation concern complicates rate path; AUD weakness pressures NIMs
sectors.implications: Cost discipline supports near-term EPS but signals weak loan growth; CBA.AX, NAB.AX, WBC.AX likely to follow similar cost actions. Rate uncertainty creates two-way risk.

sectors.trend: Oil price surge as suppression fails; Santos preservation seen as national sacrifice; fuel prices rising 30c
sectors.implications: Santos (STO.AX) and Woodside (WDS.AX) benefit from higher oil but face political pressure on pricing. LNG exporters gain. Airlines (QAN.AX) and transport hit by fuel costs.

sectors.trend: Woolworths breaches price freeze; Cramer flags consumer spending weakness; businesses fear for future; tax burden rising
sectors.implications: WES.AX, WOW.AX face margin pressure from input costs vs. pricing power limits. Consumer discretionary (SGH.AX, LPX.AX) at risk. Defensive rotation into staples likely.

sectors.trend: Bird flu confirmed in endangered sea lions (SA); McGrath Foundation receives redirected prostate cancer funding; CSL.AX stable
sectors.implications: CSL.AX, SXH.AX (Sovereign) relatively insulated. Bird flu adds biosecurity risk to agriculture and tourism. McGrath (MCF) benefits from funding shift.

sectors.trend: Housing prices crashing, first-home buyers surging; no auction bounce; RBA worried about rental inflation; new social rental build in Perth
sectors.implications: REITs (GPW.AX, ICPS.AX) face rental yield pressure but occupancy support. Property developers (DHG.AX, WBC.AX) see mixed demand. Social housing policy tailwind for new builds.

sectors.trend: Oracle adds $30bn AI contracts; tech execs call to slow AI; $760bn AI risk flagged; Neurizon among ASX runners
sectors.implications: Global AI capex cycle supports sentiment but concentration risk rising. ASX-listed Neurizon (NRZ.AX) and Iondrive (ION.AX) see small-cap momentum. Limited direct ASX AI exposure.

key_themes: Rate rise fears and AUD weakness driving broad risk-off
Commodity divergence: oil up, iron ore down, gold flat
Structural cost cutting across financials and mining
Consumer squeeze: fuel, food, tax burden rising simultaneously
Geopolitical risk premium from Russia-Poland and Arctic shipping
Small-cap mining capital raises and volatility

risk_assessment.mitigation: Reduce duration in rate-sensitive REITs and property; favour fixed-income ladders; monitor RBA statement for rental inflation guidance
Underweight BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX; diversify into gold (GOLD.AX) and energy (WDS.AX, STO.AX)
Hedge transport exposure; favour energy producers; monitor WES.AX, QAN.AX fuel cost pass-through
Reduce foreign-currency exposure; favour domestic-revenue companies; monitor AUD/USD for 0.62 support
Maintain 10-15% cash allocation; hold gold as hedge; monitor commodity supply chain disruptions
Rotate from discretionary to staples; monitor WES.AX, WOW.AX same-store sales; watch retail data
Avoid small-cap miners in active fundraising; favour large-caps with balance sheet strength

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight energy producers on oil surge
opportunities.rationale: Oil price suppression failing; Santos and Woodside benefit from higher realised prices despite political pressure

opportunities.recommendation: Add defensive staples and healthcare on risk-off rotation
opportunities.rationale: Consumer squeeze and rate fears drive rotation into defensives; CSL.AX offers dividend yield and stability

opportunities.recommendation: Selective small-cap mining on cap raise completion
opportunities.rationale: PolarX, Sunstone Metals, Manuka Resources showing momentum post-funding; Iondrive and Neurizon gaining traction

opportunities.recommendation: Gold as geopolitical and inflation hedge
opportunities.rationale: Iron ore weak but gold 'schmould' may be temporary; Russia-Poland escalation and AUD weakness support gold

defensive_moves.rationale: Active 'bloodletting' in iron ore; no near-term demand catalyst; China growth concerns persist

defensive_moves.recommendation: Trim rate-sensitive REITs and property developers
defensive_moves.rationale: RBA rental inflation concern signals potential rate hike; housing prices crashing; no auction bounce
ASX down $90bn in a week; multiple concurrent risks (oil, rates, geopolitics, growth); preserve capital

defensive_moves.recommendation: Monitor ANZ.AX cost programme for sector-wide signal
defensive_moves.rationale: 3,500 job cuts signal structural margin pressure; watch CBA, NAB, WBC for similar moves affecting earnings

market_outlook.short_term: Bearish. ASX likely to test lower supports as rate fears, oil spike, and AUD weakness compound. Iron ore weakness caps materials. Consumer squeeze pressures staples margins. Expect volatility around RBA communications and oil price action. $90bn weekly loss suggests further downside unless oil stabilises.
market_outlook.long_term: Cautiously constructive. Structural themes (AI capex, energy transition, superannuation reform) intact. Housing correction may create entry points for first-home buyers. Mining cap raises, while dilutive short-term, fund exploration pipelines. Key variable is RBA rate path and China demand recovery.
